Module 05: Reconciliation & Double-Keying — Learning Objectives

By the end of this module, students will be able to:

  • Analyze the statistical reliability of independent double-keying and explain why post-editing proofreading suffers from cognitive confirmation bias.
  • Calculate and interpret Inter-Annotator Agreement (IAA) using percentage agreement and Cohen's Kappa coefficient across historical transcription samples.
  • Execute programmatic character-level and word-level diffing in VS Code using Git and terminal utilities (diff, wdiff) to locate textual discrepancies.
  • Adjudicate competing editorial readings against high-resolution facsimiles to establish an authoritative consensus ground truth.
